# Numerical regression inputs

These fixed rows and raw values are consumed by current integer-formula and skill tests. They retain their source identity for deterministic comparison. They do not describe the complete current catalog, active balance policy or released scope; those are defined by data/rules/numerical.json and production registries.

The obsolete six-slot progression documents and stage reports are removed from docs. Existing valid current-format instances may still contain historical paid ledgers and qualification metadata; those remain validated by production persistence.
